identity.name: RiftWriter Company Limited (BVI) and RazeStaker Company Limited (BVI)

about.registryInfo:
APC3M is issued through R25 Protocol infrastructure with contracting
  parties RiftWriter Company Limited and RazeStaker Company Limited (both
  British Virgin Islands business companies per i-BVI registry). Risk curation
  is provided by Axil, whose team is publicly described as alumni of BlackRock,
  HSBC and HashKey. The vault operates as a permissioned ERC-4626 style share
  token where USDC deposits are deployed into emerging-market consumer loan
  portfolios across Mexico, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia, and Pakistan
  through a regulated private credit fund with ticket sizes of approximately 60
  to 250 US dollars and 2 to 4 month maturities. Multi-layer protection is
  described in marketing as overcollateralization, pledged bank accounts, and
  junior capital buffers. Proof of reserves is attested by APEX and smart
  contracts are audited by SlowMist.
